title: Why You Can't Buy Enlightenment: The Guru Trap (1983-03-08)
description:
Confused by the "spiritual supermarket"? Shri Mataji exposes the truth about false gurus and explains why you can never pay for your own evolution.

In this candid interview, Shri Mataji exposes the "business" of false gurus and explains why true spirituality cannot be bought. She defines Self-Realization as an evolutionary leap and concludes by guiding the journalist—and viewers—to experience the cool breeze of Kundalini awakening.

Key Topics:
• 💰 The "Guru Enterprise" - understanding why true spirituality is free and how to identify false teachers who exploit seekers for money
• ⚡ Self-Realization defined not as a mental concept, but as the actualization of the evolutionary process felt on the central nervous system
• 🔬 Healing as a by-product - how connecting to the mains of the all-pervading power naturally corrects physical and mental imbalances
• 💬 Insights on the dangers of modern cults (TM, Rajneesh) and how they damage the subtle system through possession and conditioning
• ✨ Guided experience - Shri Mataji leads the journalist and TV audience to feel the cool breeze of the Spirit (follow along at the end!)

“Self-realization is the epitome of our evolutionary process, which is a living process through which you achieve your higher Self.”
— Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi

Common Questions About Spiritual Awakening:
• How to tell the difference between a true and false guru?
• What is the meaning of self realization in Sahaja Yoga?
• Can spiritual healing cure physical diseases?

Have you ever felt confused by the "spiritual supermarket" of modern gurus? What qualities do you look for in a true teacher?

---

Archival video of an interview with H.H. Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi in Melbourne (Australia). Digitally improved file.
